claim.en: Viking gods and warriors wore horned helmets.

sources.en: No Eddic text describes a horned helmet.

origin.en: Nineteenth-century art and stage design, above all the costumes for Wagner's Ring in 1876.

sources.en: Loki is the son of the giant Fárbauti and Laufey; he and Óðinn mixed their blood in sworn brotherhood.

origin.en: Modern retellings and films turn the sworn brotherhood into kinship.
